mapper.sql: id, template_code, template_name, shift_type, start_time, end_time, cross_day, scheduled_break_minutes, color, is_active AS active
mapper.select: SELECT FROM shift_template WHERE tenant_id = #{tenantId} ORDER BY template_code ASC, id ASC
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO shift_template ( tenant_id, template_code, template_name, shift_type, start_time, end_time, cross_day, scheduled_break_minutes, color, is_active ) VALUES ( #{tenantId}, #{in.templateCode}, #{in.templateName}, #{in.shiftType}, #{in.startTime}, #{in.endTime}, CASE WHEN #{in.crossDay} THEN 1 ELSE 0 END, #{in.scheduledBreakMinutes}, #{in.color}, CASE WHEN #{in.active} THEN 1 ELSE 0 END )
mapper.update: UPDATE shift_template SET template_code = #{in.templateCode}, template_name = #{in.templateName}, shift_type = #{in.shiftType}, start_time = #{in.startTime}, end_time = #{in.endTime}, cross_day = CASE WHEN #{in.crossDay} THEN 1 ELSE 0 END, scheduled_break_minutes = #{in.scheduledBreakMinutes}, color = #{in.color}, is_active = CASE WHEN #{in.active} THEN 1 ELSE 0 END, updated_at = CURRENT_TIMESTAMP WHERE tenant_id = #{tenantId} AND id = #{id}
